aboutDesc:
Hello! My name is Nickey, and I am a 17-year-old fullstack developer. I specialize in creating backend with Java (Spring) and frontend with TypeScript (React), as well as developing bots with Java (JDA) and plugins for Bukkit API.

I offer services in creating:
• Backend for web applications with Spring
• Frontend with React and TypeScript
• Discord bots with Java (JDA)
• Minecraft plugins with Bukkit API

If you need a quality solution — feel free to contact me or my studio!
